Since tasks in MS MARCO and ACI-Bench require summarizing answers from the context, we employ metric-based judgment using ROUGE score to evaluate the similarity between generated responses and references, which provides an indirect assessment for LLM hallucinations.

Following previous studies, we conduct LLM-based judgments on LIMAEval, VicunaEval, WizardLMEval, and TruthfulQA to evaluate the hallucination rate. This metric is determined by whether the generated responses contain conflicting spans with knowledge snippets or factual information, assessed using GPT-4 (gpt-4-0613) as the evaluator.
